panels.description: The last day in the time range. Today counts so far.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "restingHeartRate" AS "Value"
FROM garmin.usersummary
WHERE "calendarDate" BETWEEN ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date AND ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})::date AND "restingHeartRate" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "calendarDate" DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.description: The time of the newest heart rate sample. It ignores the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket(($__interval_ms * interval '1 millisecond'), "timestamp", ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AS time, avg(heartrate) AS "Heart Rate"
FROM garmin."heartRateValues"
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Heart Rate
panels.description: Blue is below 60 bpm, green is 60 to 96, yellow is 96 to 110, and red is above 110, as in the distribution.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT mean_value AS "Heart rate histogram"
FROM (SELECT avg(heartrate) AS mean_value FROM garmin."heartRateValues" WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") GROUP BY time_bucket(interval '1 minute', "timestamp")) AS samples
WHERE mean_value <= 96

SELECT mean_value AS "Heart rate histogram > 96"
FROM (SELECT avg(heartrate) AS mean_value FROM garmin."heartRateValues" WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") GROUP BY time_bucket(interval '1 minute', "timestamp")) AS samples
WHERE mean_value > 96

SELECT mean_value AS "Heart rate histogram < 60"
FROM (SELECT avg(heartrate) AS mean_value FROM garmin."heartRateValues" WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") GROUP BY time_bucket(interval '1 minute', "timestamp")) AS samples
WHERE mean_value < 60

SELECT mean_value AS "Heart rate histogram > 110"
FROM (SELECT avg(heartrate) AS mean_value FROM garmin."heartRateValues" WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") GROUP BY time_bucket(interval '1 minute', "timestamp")) AS samples
WHERE mean_value > 110

SELECT time_bucket(($__interval_ms * interval '1 millisecond'), "timestamp", ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AS time, avg(respiration) AS "BR"
FROM garmin."respirationValuesArray"
WHERE respiration >= 0 AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(($__interval_ms * interval '1 millisecond'), "timestamp", ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AS time, avg("stressLevel") AS "Stress"
FROM garmin."stressValuesArray"
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND "stressLevel" >= 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(($__interval_ms * interval '1 millisecond'), "timestamp", ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AS time, avg("bodyBatteryLevel") AS "Body Battery"
FROM garmin."bodyBatteryValuesArray"
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Sleep stages on the same time axis as the panels above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT "startGMT" AS time, CASE "activityLevel" WHEN 0 THEN 'Deep' WHEN 1 THEN 'Light' WHEN 2 THEN 'REM' WHEN 3 THEN 'Awake' END AS "Stage"
FROM garmin."sleepLevels"
WHERE "endGMT" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND "startGMT" <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
UNION ALL
SELECT l."endGMT", NULL
FROM garmin."sleepLevels" l
WHERE l."endGMT" >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND l."startGMT" <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM garmin."sleepLevels" n WHERE n."startGMT" = l."endGMT")
ORDER BY 1
